title: Publish a clearer current-vs-historical authority map
description: Update the high-visibility docs layer so contributors and operators can immediately distinguish current authority surfaces from historical planning and design references.

criteria: There is one obvious path to current runtime and release authority
Historical docs remain accessible but explicitly bounded as reference only
README and docs index point to the same current-authority surfaces
convergence.verification: Search touched docs for contradictory current-authority language and confirm the updated index/readme point to the same authority set.
convergence.definition_of_done: The high-visibility docs layer no longer forces readers to infer what is current versus historical.

implementation.title: Add authority guidance
implementation.description: Introduce concise current-versus-historical guidance in the highest-visibility docs.

implementation.title: Bound historical references
implementation.description: Mark retained roadmap and design artifacts as historical or compatibility references where needed.

implementation.title: Unify operator entrypoints
implementation.description: Make README and docs index send readers to the same current authority sources.
